option_relations.rationale: Organizing pneumonia is a pattern of lung injury, not the primary diagnosis in this context. While it can be secondary to COVID-19, the question asks for the most likely diagnosis of the patient's overall condition, which is the infection itself.
Long COVID refers to persistent symptoms after the acute phase of infection. The vignette describes an active infection with progressive lung findings and positive PCR, not a post-acute syndrome.
The option 'SARS-CoV-2 (COVID-19) pneumonia' is clinically equivalent to the leaf 'COVID-19 pneumonia'.
The option 'COVID-19 pneumonia (SARS-CoV-2 infection)' is clinically equivalent to the leaf 'COVID-19 pneumonia'.
